Plastic?\nIn today's industrial landscape, plastic plays a crucial role as it is both versatile and efficient. Here are six reasons why plastic is often the preferred choice:\n- Better glide properties\n- High wear resistance\n- Chemical resistance\n- Biocompatibility\n- Electrical insulation\n- Low weight\nPlastic Processing\nContact Us\nPlastics are often processed through injection molding. However, a subtractive machining process – as practiced in our company – is often more sensible in many cases, as the quantity does not justify the cost of an injection molding tool (prototype construction, small to medium series), and a machined part often exhibits more favorable mechanical properties than an injection molded part (surface, fiber orientation, strength). Furthermore, faster production of the parts can lead to shorter delivery times, as no individual tool needs to be manufactured, allowing for a quick response to changes in the part.\nUtilize our expertise for your product as well – we specialize in manufacturing your custom solution cost-effectively and to high quality standards – whether it is for prototypes or series parts!","external_url":"https://www.alfred-schweizer.de/kunststoffe","id":"09a7fed4-6186-446e-8ab5-9af100af37c6","images":[],"is_indexable":false,"is_published":false,"is_similar":false,"is_top_product":true,"keywords":["Plastic processing","Injection Molding","wear resistance"],"language":"de","minimum_order_quantity":{},"name":"Plastic Processing","product_attributes":[],"product_profile_url":"https://www.wlw.de/en/company/alfred-schweizer-gmbh-co-kg-658260/products/kunststoffverarbeitung-36331720","short_description":"Kunststoffverarbeitung \n","slug":"36331720","uuid":"09a7fed4-6186-446e-8ab5-9af100af37c6","videos":[]},"template":{"templateBin":"","templateName":"tap_test","templateType":"dx","templateUrl":"https://dinamicx.alibabausercontent.com/pub/tap_test/1787280083854/tap_test.zip","timestamp":1787329667813,"version":"3.0.0"}}
